Patch notes 1.1.3
Patch notes 1.1.2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/8a287c117b8749bc4db2a245505989d15408ab31.jpg[/img]

[b]Skills[/b]

Ghost: The character is no longer invisible during the skill, as indicated in the spell description.

Gigantism: It is now easier to hit opponents when the character is enlarged.

Dragon's Claw: The scope of the skill has been increased.


[b]Actives[/b]

The Middle Shield can now have the active Shield Protection.


[b]General[/b]

Melee Weapon Hitbox has been adjusted to more easily hit enemies.

Integration and redesign of the store in game (Minions improvement, shop of consumable and implants).


[b]Balancing[/b]

The base power of minions is no longer tied to the level of his team. The power increases every 2 minutes. After 20 minutes the base power of the minions no longer increases the game.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/29d48df3a7e0330a99e44419104d549833b87e6b.jpg[/img]

[b]Skills[/b]

Cannonade: The slowdown has been increased to 35%

Care: targeting has been improved

Dragon's Claw: Targeting has been improved

Flame Trail: Fixed application of burns on minions

Wisp : Wisps can no longer be cast if there are no nearby enemies


[b]Neutral creatures[/b]

The duration of the bonus effect of the big Matryss has been reduced to 60 seconds and it is no longer possible to recover the same bonus several times.

The health of the big Matryss is now 500 and increases by 20 every 2 minutes.

Life Points of the Little Matryss is now 200 and increases by 20 every 2 minutes.

Life of Mercenary Dervyss is now 600 * NbDeplayers and increases by 100 every 2 minutes.


[b]Game[/b]

Lobby fix that allowed to choose a badly equipped character

Leaving the lobby now frees the place

notes.title: Patch note EA 1.0.13
notes.content:
[b]Nouveautés[/b]

Les parties rapides ont été remplacées par un menu de création de partie personnalisée

Le vaisseau a été décoré pour les fêtes de noel


[b]Correctifs[/b]

De nombreuses optimisations reseau ont été réalisés afin d’améliorer la stabilité du jeu

Correction d’un bug qui faisait apparaître plusieurs fois les Matryss

L’or gagné en partie est désormais sauvegardé pour être récupéré après une reconnection, les implants ne sont pas encore récupérables.

L’interface de réapparition après une désactivation est de nouveau affichée à l’écran

La compétence Soin peut desormais etre utilisé à travers les boucliers des tours

La compétence Soin n'interrompt plus le retour à la base 

La couleur des barres de vies des unités invincible a été modifié selon l’équipe pour une meilleur lisibilité

Le nom des personnages est désormais visible sur le menu de sélection

L’interface de sélection de personnage dans le lobby a été modifiée pour s’adapter à toutes les résolutions d’écran

Ajout d’une notification au-dessus du magasin pour plus de clarté

Les animations de course ont été retravaillées

notes.title: Patch note EA 1.0.10
notes.content:
[b]Adding the cane[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/5dce6677acc33dd01e831f188625389bebc2127f.jpg[/img]
The cane seems to be a classic short stick but it's a relic allowing to her carrier to reach a state of extreme concentration wich is necessary to the practice of care on the allies. 

[b]Adding the Back pieces of equipment:[/b]
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/6e246b1b649146bd4dab9e5ba0927cd4cf3ae951.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/07d60061b58057fb39adc559f9549664d3f8c08c.jpg[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/a2212d583b1db106d004e98141ac00c808e17488.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/5c8f599137245bc4be89d04cb10ac63807d54a59.jpg[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/3878660c4e3fbe73e018429cb0d31dab61e6f5e1.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/411c81ee04137327bf6b762f918cc1bb84268ae0.jpg[/img][/url]

This stuffs increase the caracter stats.

[b]Fixes and balancing[/b]

The shooter Crockyss reveal an ammunition box for all the opponents when he died.
Ammunition cost is now 10 gold instead of 25.
Correction of the display of the players name above the avatar.
Correction of a bug of display about the recharge time of  the actives.
The gun damages were reduce at 4 damages instead of 10 basics damages.
The towers IA  were reworking to attack first the Crockyss then change their priority if a player attack an other player under the tower.
The team who's disable a tower now receive a gold reward.
Graphics elements from Pirate's haunt were optimised to reduce the FPS decline on certains points of the map.
The minimap is larger.
Correction of a bug of display at the caracter creation that was blocking the entire menu.
Adding a button to delete a caracter.
Correction of the training button that was prevent the game launching while being solo.

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.7a
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/37514388551e2d4c857bef04b111cb3ff612e004.png[/img]
-Towers has been put back at the correct place in the pirate den.
-Tooltips doesn’t show anymore if they have no text.
-Fix visual bugs in character selection.
-Speed boost at game start is now weaker and has shorter duration.
-3D modelers can’t be destroyed anymore.
-Spaceship is now at its first visual level. Until now it was at its third level.
-Add expendables in ingame shop.
-Icons showing stuff type slots in character creation are now behind stuff icons.
-Gun FX don’t appear anymore when we try to shoot with no ammo.
-Add a statistic reset button in character creation.
-Tower health point has been lowered from 8000 to 4000.
-Add a message “Foncez sur l’Octryss” (not yet translated) at match start to indicate Octryss deactivation importance.
-Chat update.

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.7
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30519334/0c7524f914354c2319f3ac491fc6aa91837db602.png[/img]

Bugs fix :

-Unable Gold when the player is disable.

-Matryss Jungle: Replaced attacks, increased spawn and respawn duration (2’30’’ to respawn and 2’ to spawn)

-Changing the ammunition price from 25 Gold to 10 Gold.

-Double Gun active: doubled cooldown from 30’’ to 60’’.

-Jungle: put the names of neutral monster and bosses.

-Adding an upgrade button for skills in the HUD.

-Player Spawn : the payers can move in the base but they are blocked until the game is launched. At the end of the loading time, the players can move and buy implants.  There is a speed buff  during the base outing.

-Correction of the possibility to launch skills when the player is dead.
Balancing :

-The health of bosses pass from 8000 HP to 10000 HP.

-The health points of turrets pass from 5000 to 8000 HP.

-The basic attack of the turrets deals now 100 damage and increase by 25 per stroke on the same target.

-The life steal of attacks and spells has been corrected.

-The tutorial has been temporarily disable. The player can select his first stuff during the first character creation.
